subject.title: feat: add Fedora/RHEL-family platform support with rootless Podman

question: Should this installer permanently support Fedora/RHEL-family hosts with rootless Podman Quadlets in addition to its current Debian/Ubuntu Docker contract?
rationale: This is a broad new operational and security-support surface rather than a repair to an established behavior; source inspection confirms current main and repository policy are Debian/Ubuntu-specific.

options.title: Sponsor dual-platform support
options.body: Accept Fedora/RHEL rootless Podman as a supported contract, then require the documentation repair and real-host validation before merge.

options.title: Keep the current platform boundary
options.body: Decline the new Fedora/RHEL support contract and retain the existing Debian/Ubuntu Docker-focused installer scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor dual-platform support
recommendation.body: Accept Fedora/RHEL rootless Podman as a supported contract, then require the documentation repair and real-host validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct technical context for the proposed Podman implementation; final support-policy approval remains a repository maintainer decision.
